prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (Juniper) intakes, triages, dispatches, coordinates under approved protocols; jurisdictions retain resource ownership/local policy. Juniper creates incident records, preserves reports/clarifications, tracks coverage, escalates gaps, retains audit evidence under approved access/retention controls, and reviews service measures at defined cadence against approved thresholds. Call Taker Mara (Larkspur) confirms/repeats location before medical details, distinguishes observed/reported facts, obtains pediatric age/available weight/caregiver observations, updates records before dispatch, produces Caller Location Correction Slip; confirms incident ID/facility before destination requests, receives Bedside Arrival Receipt, verifies arrival time. Computer Aided Dispatch Console presents incident/priority/maps/travel/availability/constraints/staging/surge/latest confirmed unit status with time/source; verify currency; test against approved scenarios before regional-use change authorization. Triage Supervisor (Copperfield) reviews uncertain/conflicting/deteriorating/severe cases and cases where acuity/escalation timing may affect risk; assigns/document priorities by immediacy, time sensitivity, deterioration risk; urgent threats get highest available priority/prompt dispatch. Sends Pediatric Acuity Note, advises repositioning, refers unusual cases to Regional Medical Director when time permits, approves/documents temporary overrides, reviews audit memo before duplicate closure. Regional Medical Director sets policy/advises clinical needs, elevated-demand priorities, specialized/protocol destinations; no dispatch authority; reviews findings and approves clinical guidance changes within regional authority. Data Quality Officer (Pebble) flags defects, audits completeness/compliance/rationales, sends Duplicate Incident Audit Memo, routes corrections; reviews timestamp conflicts, incomplete arrival/handover fields/discrepancies without delaying care; cannot change priority. Audit findings identify records, criteria, limitations; material findings assigned owner/due date/closure-verification method. Corrective actions verified for completion and effectiveness; recurring issues assessed systemically; lessons incorporated into procedures/training/maintenance/release criteria. Ambulance Coordination Platform consolidates suitable units, timestamps status/movement, preserves queued updates through brief interruptions, flags reconciliation; selection considers priority, need, travel, capability/readiness, constraints, coverage; tracks accepted mutual aid separately; monitored for availability, response, integrity, interface failures. Changes assessed for operational/clinical/security/continuity impacts; approvals record owner, test evidence, limits, rollback. Fleet Maintenance Cell uses Mutual Aid Release Form for accountable maintenance/availability records; schedules preventive work per manufacturer guidance, history, regional needs; records asset, work, parts,

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
